title: Public element sets against reconstructed orbits: a record-controlled reference benchmark
description: Dated completeness correction to v2 (doi:10.5281/zenodo.22661809), published on 2026-09-08. This version supplies the 24 omitted project-generated files and the derived artefacts needed by a clean checkout. The evidence object and supporting artefacts remove private paths, account and machine identifiers and execution traces; embedded third-party records are replaced by source identifiers and content hashes. Original and replacement hashes are disclosed. All 52 published table blocks and 107 existing paper substitutions are unchanged, with zero invariant differences. No scientific result, method or interpretation changes. The September replay remains a retrospective physical diagnostic, and both learned-propagator checkpoints remain negative findings.
notes: Code is MIT licensed; third-party data retain their source terms. Measured MeerKAT beam data are CC BY-NC 4.0 and used for research only. The three raw provider snapshots are excluded and must be fetched from source and verified against their recorded hashes. The release provides the corrected paper PDF, scrubbed evidence object, unchanged tables, individual omitted artefacts, a hash-addressed derived-artefact archive, SHA256SUMS and publication-contract tests that restore absent assets and verify their hashes. The original v2 tag and history remain unchanged.
